distanceMethods.esa: Parsed from the existing ESA/Hubble distance field; original text and sourceUrl are preserved.
distanceMethods.estimate_xref: Estimated from a consistent ESA/Hubble distance on another catalog record sharing the same object alias; distanceSourceArchiveId identifies the record.
distanceMethods.estimate_z_ad: Estimated angular-diameter distance from the existing redshift using flat Lambda-CDM (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7).
distanceMethods.unresolved: No defensible distance was available in this pass.
distanceMethods.estimate_z_light_travel_0017: Light-travel distance from measured/retained redshift using flat Lambda-CDM (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7); angular-diameter distance is stored separately for physical-size calculations.

sizeMethods.approx_fov_upper: Approximate full-frame physical scale from distance x Hubble field-of-view angle in radians. This is an upper-bound proxy, not a claim that the target fills the image.
sizeMethods.unresolved: Distance and/or field of view was unavailable or unsuitable.

ageMethods.unresolved: Galaxy age requires object-specific stellar-population/literature evidence and is not inferred from distance or redshift.

cosmologyForRedshiftEstimates.distanceType: light-travel distance for Viewer display; angular-diameter distance retained separately for transverse size

currentSemantics.age: lookback time / age as seen today; stellar-population ages are stored separately when available
currentSemantics.distance: light-travel distance where cosmological/derived; published object distance for nearby galaxies; angular-diameter distance stored separately when needed for size
currentSemantics.size: estimated full-frame physical image span unless a record explicitly carries a manual/object size method
currentSemantics.coordinates: primary RA/Dec/constellation exclude low-confidence representative/unverified positions; quarantined representative positions are retained in *0017 fields
